# Shirur Kirani Stores

> Trusted family-owned grocery and general store in Navanagar, Hubballi, Karnataka. Serving the neighborhood since 1996 with quality groceries, genuine pricing and home delivery via WhatsApp.

Shirur Kirani Stores is located at Karnataka Circle, Navanagar, Hubballi, Karnataka, India. Contact: +91 96110 94379. Open daily 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM.
